kind.description: `human`: a person, whose annotations are signed human:<id>. Default agent.

query.description: May call the optional sixth tool, query (read-only SQL), when the server enables it. SQL reads past `reads`, so it is off unless true. Default false.

reads.description: What it may see. Absent: everything.

kinds.description: Entity kinds it may read. Absent: every kind.

relations.description: Relations it may read. Absent: every relation.

writes.description: Scopes it may annotate. Never global. Default [task, agent].

allOf.description: True when every condition is; null propagates unless one is false.

anyOf.description: True when any condition is; null propagates unless one is true.

holidays.description: ISO dates that are not business days.

weekend.description: Weekday names that are not business days. Default [saturday, sunday].

condition.description: A condition: a leaf on one predicate, all/any/not, or via a relation.

consolidation.description: One consolidation job: episodic facts reduced into one durable fact per subject.

scopes.description: Scopes to read. Default [task]; agent memory only when listed.

predicate.description: The predicate to write. Differs from from.predicate.

scope.description: The scope of the written fact. Default tenant.

min_count.description: How many observations make a pattern. Default 2.

reduce.description: How to reduce the facts. Default mode. `summary` asks a Summarizer adapter for one sentence; the rest are deterministic.

within.description: Only memory whose valid_from falls in this window, e.g. `30d`.
within.markdownDescription: Only memory whose `valid_from` falls in this window, e.g. `30d`.

context.description: How much `context` carries: relations listed, and neighbours read with depth=1, per relation and direction. The rest is counted in `relations_more` and `neighbors_more`.
context.markdownDescription:
How much `context` carries: relations listed, and neighbours read with `depth=1`, per relation and direction. The rest is counted in `relations_more` and `neighbors_more`.

```yaml
context: { relations: 10, neighbors: 5 }
```

neighbors.description: Neighbours read with depth=1 per relation and direction, the most recent ones. Default 5.

relations.description: Relations listed per relation and direction, the most recent ones. Default 10.

attrs.description: Attributes its handlers set on the entity (upsert_entity), shown as columns of the generated `<kind>_state_at` view (keel/sqlgen.py).

description.description: What this kind is, in the product's words.

facts.description: The predicates its facts hold, for the generated SQL (keel/sqlgen.py): one column each in `<kind>_state_at`, and the changes `<kind>_changes` lists. A list of names, or name -> payload hint or {type, description}; without a type, the hint of the payload field of the same name in the kind's events.
facts.markdownDescription:
The predicates its facts hold, for the generated SQL (keel/sqlgen.py): one column each in `<kind>_state_at`, and the changes `<kind>_changes` lists.

```yaml
facts: [status, assignee]
# or
facts:
  status: [open, in_progress, done]
  amount: { type: number | null, description: What the customer owes. }
  note:          # the type of the payload field `note` in this kind's events, if any
```

ref.description: Where `ref` points in the system of record, e.g. `patients.id`. Keel holds pointers, not copies.

forgets.description: `tenant`: the event erases its tenant. `before`: it deletes what closed before it. Either way it takes no handler.
forgets.markdownDescription:
- `tenant`: the event erases everything Keel stores for its tenant
- `before`: it deletes the tenant's facts and relations that closed before `occurred_at`

Either way the event takes no handler.

owner.description: Who owns this event's shape. Recommended.

payload.description: The payload fields handlers need: field -> hint. Extra fields in a payload are allowed. A single hint string is accepted too.
payload.markdownDescription:
The payload fields handlers need: field -> hint. Extra fields in a payload are allowed.

A payload field's shape, in Keel's short notation:

| Written as | Means |
| --- | --- |
| `string`, `int`, `number`, `bool`, `date`, `datetime`, `any` | a scalar |
| `number \| null` | optional and nullable |
| `string[]` | array of scalars |
| `[pending, paid]` | enum of literals |
| `[new, done, null]` | optional enum |
| `[ { id: string, qty: int } ]` | array of objects |
| `{ source: string, score: number }` | nested object |

An unknown hint is an error, so a typo never passes as `any`. `[string]` is rejected: write `string[]`.

description.description: What the fact means, for the agents reading the generated SQL.

fact.description: One declared fact: its payload hint, or {type, description}, or nothing (the type comes from the event catalog).

leaf.description: A leaf: operators on the subject's open fact for `predicate`.

eq.description: The open fact's value equals this.

gt.description: The open fact's value is greater than this.

gte.description: The open fact's value is greater than or equal to this.

held_for_business_days.markdownDescription:
Like `held_for_days`, in business days.

A comparison mapping, e.g. `{ gte: 7 }`.

held_for_days.description: How long the leaf's comparison has held across consecutive facts, in calendar days. Survives a change from one matching value to another.
held_for_days.markdownDescription:
How long the leaf's comparison has held across consecutive facts, in calendar days. Survives a change from one matching value to another.

A comparison mapping, e.g. `{ gte: 7 }`.

in.description: The open fact's value is in this list.

lt.description: The open fact's value is less than this.

lte.description: The open fact's value is less than or equal to this.

ne.description: The open fact's value differs from this.

open_for_business_days.description: How long the open fact has been open, in business days (skips `calendar` weekend and holidays).
open_for_business_days.markdownDescription:
How long the open fact has been open, in business days (skips `calendar` weekend and holidays).

A comparison mapping, e.g. `{ gte: 7 }`.

open_for_days.description: How long the open fact has been open, in calendar days.
open_for_days.markdownDescription:
How long the open fact has been open, in calendar days.

A comparison mapping, e.g. `{ gte: 7 }`.

predicate.description: The predicate whose open fact the operators test. No open fact makes the leaf null.

within_days.description: A date value on or before as_of plus this many days. Dates already past count.

memory.description: Memory policy per scope. Defaults: global and tenant never expire and require evidence; task 14d; agent 1d.

evidence.description: What counts as evidence in those scopes: event (an event the tenant's log applied to the same subject) or a ref prefix such as photo: or human:. Absent: any non-empty string.

requires_evidence.description: Scopes where annotate requires evidence. Default [global, tenant].

agent.description: How long memory in this scope lives: `never` (or `forever`), a number with a unit (`14d`, `12h`, `30m`), or a bare number of days.
agent.markdownDescription:
How long memory in this scope lives.

- `never` or `forever`: no expiry
- `<n>d`, `<n>h`, `<n>m`: days, hours, minutes (`14d`, `12h`, `1.5d`)
- a bare number: days

global.description: How long memory in this scope lives: `never` (or `forever`), a number with a unit (`14d`, `12h`, `30m`), or a bare number of days.
global.markdownDescription:
How long memory in this scope lives.

- `never` or `forever`: no expiry
- `<n>d`, `<n>h`, `<n>m`: days, hours, minutes (`14d`, `12h`, `1.5d`)
- a bare number: days

task.description: How long memory in this scope lives: `never` (or `forever`), a number with a unit (`14d`, `12h`, `30m`), or a bare number of days.
task.markdownDescription:
How long memory in this scope lives.

- `never` or `forever`: no expiry
- `<n>d`, `<n>h`, `<n>m`: days, hours, minutes (`14d`, `12h`, `1.5d`)
- a bare number: days

tenant.description: How long memory in this scope lives: `never` (or `forever`), a number with a unit (`14d`, `12h`, `30m`), or a bare number of days.
tenant.markdownDescription:
How long memory in this scope lives.

- `never` or `forever`: no expiry
- `<n>d`, `<n>h`, `<n>m`: days, hours, minutes (`14d`, `12h`, `1.5d`)
- a bare number: days

notOf.description: The negation of one condition; null stays null.

anyOf.description: A scalar hint, optionally `[]` (array) and `| null` (optional).
An enum of literals; `null` in the list makes it optional.
An array of objects: one mapping in a list.

payloadHint.description: A payload field's shape: a scalar hint, `T | null`, `T[]`, a list of literals (enum), `[ {...} ]` or a nested mapping.
payloadHint.markdownDescription:
A payload field's shape, in Keel's short notation:

| Written as | Means |
| --- | --- |
| `string`, `int`, `number`, `bool`, `date`, `datetime`, `any` | a scalar |
| `number \| null` | optional and nullable |
| `string[]` | array of scalars |
| `[pending, paid]` | enum of literals |
| `[new, done, null]` | optional enum |
| `[ { id: string, qty: int } ]` | array of objects |
| `{ source: string, score: number }` | nested object |

An unknown hint is an error, so a typo never passes as `any`. `[string]` is rejected: write `string[]`.

multi.description: One open value per author instead of last-writer-wins; context lists conflicts.

relation.description: A relation between two entity kinds.

one.description: A source holds at most one target at a time: the generated `<kind>_state_at` view (keel/sqlgen.py) shows the target's id in a column named after the relation.

symmetric.description: Recorded from either end, shown once (direction `both`).

rule.description: A semantic definition. The core reads `applies_to` and `when`; every other key is a parameter agents read.
rule.markdownDescription:
A semantic definition. The core reads `applies_to` and `when`; every other key (`threshold_mm`, `days`) is a parameter agents read.

```yaml
tire_critical:
  applies_to: tire
  definition: A tire is critical when tread depth is below 3 mm.
  threshold_mm: 3
  when: { predicate: depth_mm, lt: 3 }
```

applies_to.description: The entity kind the rule is about. Absent: every subject.

definition.description: The rule in words, for people and agents.

when.description: A condition the core evaluates in `context`: true, false or null. A list means all of them. Absent: the rule is a definition only.

semantic.description: What `keel index` puts in each subject's document for semantic search.

attrs.description: Entity attributes in the document: true (default), false, or a list of names.

exclude.description: Predicates to leave out. Use this or `predicates`, not both.

kinds.description: Kinds to index. Absent: every kind.

labels.description: Attributes that label the other side of a relation; the first present wins. Default: name, nombre, title, titulo, label, plate, model.

lexical_weight.description: Hybrid search: weight of the lexical leg. 0 is dense only. Default 0.3.

min_score.description: Drop results below this cosine. Model-specific: calibrate with evals.

predicates.description: Predicates to include. Use this or `exclude`, not both.

relations.description: Open relations to include: the other side's key and one label.

split.description: kind -> predicates: also one document per open fact of these predicates, and per element of a list value.

via.description: Follow a relation and test each neighbour. No neighbours: `any` is false, `all` is true.

any.description: At least one neighbour meets this condition.

direction.description: Which way to follow the relation. Default any; symmetric relations ignore it.

cartridge.description: cartridge.yaml: the ontology, event catalog, rules, memory policy and agent registry of one domain. See docs/SPEC.md section 5.

agents.description: The agent registry: id -> spec. Absent means no registry: any caller, any scope with evidence. With it, every Tools instance is bound to a declared agent.
agents.markdownDescription:
The agent registry: id -> spec. Absent means no registry: any caller, any scope with evidence. With it, every `Tools` instance is bound to a declared agent.

```yaml
agents:
  tires-bot:
    description: Reads tire depth, writes task memory.
    writes: [task, agent]
    reads: { kinds: [unit, tire], relations: [mounted_on] }
  dispatcher:
    kind: human
    writes: [task, tenant]
```

consolidate.description: Episodic memory summarized into durable facts by `keel consolidate`: name -> job. A job, never part of ingest.

entities.description: The kinds of things the product is about: kind -> spec. Subjects are written `<kind>:<id>`.
entities.markdownDescription:
The kinds of things the product is about: kind -> spec. Subjects are written `<kind>:<id>`.

```yaml
entities:
  patient: { description: A person treated at the clinic., ref: patients.id }
```

events.description: The event catalog: dotted lowercase type -> spec. Every type has a handler in handlers.py, except one that forgets.
events.markdownDescription:
The event catalog: dotted lowercase type -> spec. Every type has a handler in `handlers.py`, except one that `forgets`.

```yaml
events:
  appointment.booked:
    subject: appointment
    owner: scheduling-team
    payload: { patient_id: string, starts_at: datetime }
```

name.description: The cartridge's name, a slug. Defaults to the folder name.

predicates.description: Write policy per predicate, for annotations: predicate -> {multi, description}.

relations.description: How kinds relate: relation -> {from, to}. Both ends are declared entity kinds.
relations.markdownDescription:
How kinds relate: relation -> `{from, to}`. Both ends are declared entity kinds.

```yaml
relations:
  booked_by: { from: appointment, to: patient }
```

rules.description: Semantic definitions, versioned with the cartridge: name -> rule. `context` returns them for the subject's kind and evaluates their `when`.

version.description: The cartridge's own version. Recorded on every annotation with a hash of the rules.
